name: workspace-insight
description: 给智能体一个「看清工作区」的工具：统计代码规模、找出最大的文件、列出最近改动的文件。适合在动手前快速摸清一个陌生项目。
author: SHE built-in

tools.name: ws_overview
tools.description: Summarise the workspace: file count, total lines by extension, the largest files, and the most recently modified files. Use this to orient yourself in an unfamiliar project before making changes.
